stem:
The diagram shows Zubin keeping the metal point fixed at P with the compass open to a fixed length, and moving only the pencil.

What path does the pencil draw?

options.text: A circle with centre P, and with every pencil point at the same fixed distance from P.
A circle whose radius is the point P.
A circle with centre at the moving pencil tip, and with P on the rim.

teacher.key_rationale: Fixed point at P and fixed opening make every pencil position the same distance from P, so the path is a circle centred at P. Calling P the radius swaps terms. Putting the centre at the pencil reverses roles. A straight line confuses the compass motion with a ruler.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote right triangle source into a compass arc at P; stem refers to the diagram.
